content:
Why Cron Jobs Break Under High Load (And What To Build Instead):

Swipe through the visual blueprint to see the exact state transition diagram:
Slide 1: The Cron Overlap Trap (Concurrent worker collision)
Slide 2: Atomic State Machine (QUEUED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED)
Slide 3: Heartbeat Timeout & Recovery

Building resilient background jobs doesn't require Kubernetes. A hardened SQLite database with WAL mode provides sub-millisecond local locks.

#SystemDesign #BackendEngineering #DevOps #Architecture
